Request: Create the file /etc/file.txt with the contents ``beginning'' if it does not already exist
Initial states: baseline: file absent; adversarial: file contains exactly existing content.
Playbook:
---
- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Ensure /etc/file.txt exists with content 'beginning'
    ansible.builtin.copy:
      dest: /etc/file.txt
      content: "beginning"
      mode: '0644'
      owner: root
      group: root
    when: not ansible.builtin.stat(path="/etc/file.txt").stat.exists
